roadmap.title: Accounts, editor, and record times
roadmap.description: Sign in for ratings, favorites, and saved replays. Complete the editor tasks and start earning fastest times on levels with at least 10 competitors.

roadmap.title: Featured Levels
roadmap.description: Work through the winnable Featured Levels and finish three with each character. Tackle the two timed levels and defeat Gravelord Tito in PARK SOULS.

roadmap.title: Character tricks and survival
roadmap.description: Use the named levels for vehicle tricks, magnet tasks, and victories with injuries or missing passengers.

roadmap.title: Cumulative counters
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining deaths, body damage, mower, token, distance, and distinct-level counters using the dedicated levels.

achievements.summary: Destroy 1,000 heads by crushing them.

steps.text: Search for @loc{Free Your Minds} by Redemtor1 in the Level Browser. Crush the NPC heads and replay the level until the counter reaches 1,000.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 10 player deaths.

steps.text: Play damage-heavy @mechanic{Dont Move} levels and restart after each death until your death count reaches 10.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 100 player deaths.

steps.text: Play damage-heavy @mechanic{Dont Move} levels and restart after each death until your death count reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 1,000 player deaths.

steps.text: Play damage-heavy @mechanic{Dont Move} levels and restart after each death until your death count reaches 1,000.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 50 severed limbs.

guide.context: Limbs lost by NPCs also count.

steps.text: Use damage-heavy levels to tear off arms and legs until the limb counter reaches 50.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 500 severed limbs.

guide.context: Limbs lost by NPCs also count.

steps.text: Use damage-heavy levels to tear off arms and legs until the limb counter reaches 500.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 5,000 severed limbs.

guide.context: Limbs lost by NPCs also count.

steps.text: Use damage-heavy levels to tear off arms and legs until the limb counter reaches 5,000.

achievements.summary: Have your character decapitated 500 times.

guide.context: The head must come off; crushing the head is a different counter.

steps.text: Use @loc{enlightened 1} by BooperDuperTrooper to sever your character’s head. Restart after each decapitation until you reach 500.

achievements.summary: Expose a cumulative 1,000 lengths of intestine.

steps.text: Play damage-heavy levels that tear your character’s torso apart and expose intestines. Restart and continue until the intestine counter reaches 1,000.

achievements.summary: Expose a total of 1,000 hearts.

steps.text: Play damage-heavy @mechanic{Dont Move} levels that tear bodies open and release hearts. Replay them until 1,000 hearts have been exposed.

achievements.summary: Expose a cumulative 1,000 vertebrae.

steps.text: Use damage-heavy levels that split your character’s body and expose the spine. Continue until the vertebrae counter reaches 1,000.

achievements.summary: Restart the same level 20 consecutive times.

steps.text: Open a level, then press @mechanic{Tab} followed by @mechanic{R} to restart. Do this 20 times on that level.

achievements.summary: Break your own vehicle 500 times.

steps.text: Search for @loc{It Wasn’t My Fault} by murrrrrrrr. Break your vehicle, restart, and continue until you have destroyed 500 vehicles.

achievements.summary: Accelerate a character to the maximum speed.

steps.text: Play @loc{SPEED IS KEY!!} by sammyplayzO56 and use the level’s speed setup to reach maximum speed.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 100 deaths of Santa Claus’s elves.

steps.text: Play @loc{Downsizing} by fatsogage as @npc{Santa Claus}. Let the elves die, then restart until 100 elf deaths have counted.

achievements.description: Do a Backflip While on Vehicle
achievements.summary: Perform a backflip while riding a vehicle.

steps.text: Play @loc{Redundant Ostentati} by Pixelzocker. Stay on the vehicle and rotate backward once before landing.

achievements.description: Do a Double Backflip While on Vehicle
achievements.summary: Perform a double backflip while riding a vehicle.

steps.text: Play @loc{Redundant Ostentati} by Pixelzocker. Stay on the vehicle and rotate backward twice in one jump before landing.

achievements.description: Do a Frontflip While on Vehicle
achievements.summary: Perform a frontflip while riding a vehicle.

steps.text: Play @loc{Redundant Ostentati} by Pixelzocker. Stay on the vehicle and rotate forward once before landing.

achievements.description: Do a Double Frontflip While on Vehicle
achievements.summary: Perform a double frontflip while riding a vehicle.

steps.text: Play @loc{Redundant Ostentati} by Pixelzocker. Stay on the vehicle and rotate forward twice in one jump before landing.

achievements.description: Throw a Sword into Someone's Head
achievements.summary: Throw a sword so that the blade lodges in someone’s head.

steps.text: Play a @mechanic{Sword Throw} level and throw a sword into a target’s head.

achievements.summary: Pick up and throw a severed head.

steps.text: Play @loc{You Forgot This!} by HexiDummy. Grab the head that drops to your hands, then throw the head away.

achievements.summary: Have your character impaled 500 times.

steps.text: Play @loc{Get Back Out There} by ZMXNCBVQ and let the sharp objects impale your character. Restart with @mechanic{Tab}, then @mechanic{R}, until 500 impalements have counted.

achievements.description: Harpoon Son's Head to a Wall
achievements.summary: Pin Irresponsible Dad’s son to a wall with a harpoon through the son’s head.

steps.text: Play @loc{stick around kid} by Xadel345 as @npc{Irresponsible Dad}. Line up the son’s head with the harpoon so the harpoon pins his head to the wall.

achievements.summary: Impale Irresponsible Dad and his son together with one harpoon.

steps.text: Play @loc{Stay Close, Son} by TheDaishax as @npc{Irresponsible Dad}. Let one harpoon pass through both father and son.

achievements.summary: Shred 100 torsos with Lawnmower Man’s mower.

steps.text: Play @loc{Wrong Tool for t Job} by onyxeagle274 as @npc{Lawnmower Man}. Feed the torsos into the mower and replay until 100 have been shredded.

achievements.summary: Shred 100 pieces of fruit with Lawnmower Man’s mower.

steps.text: Play @loc{Smoothie Deluxe} by SpookedSpooks as @npc{Lawnmower Man}. Feed the pieces of fruit into the mower and replay until 100 have been shredded.

achievements.summary: Shred 100 brains with Lawnmower Man’s mower.

steps.text: Play @loc{Voracious} by Foxietty as @npc{Lawnmower Man}. Feed the brains into the mower and replay until 100 have been shredded.

achievements.summary: Shred Lawnmower Man’s own head with his mower.

steps.text: Play @loc{User Error} by huggeboy44 as @npc{Lawnmower Man} and let the setup drop your head into your mower.

achievements.description: Hover For 10 Seconds With Rocket Chair
achievements.summary: Stay airborne in Wheelchair Guy’s rocket chair for 10 seconds.

steps.text: Play @loc{Jetsetter} by XIANTHEMONKEY as @npc{Wheelchair Guy}.
Hold @mechanic{Space} to fire the rocket. Adjust the jet with @mechanic{Shift} and @mechanic{Ctrl} to stay above the ground for 10 seconds.

achievements.summary: Reach a height of 10 meters in a jump on Pogostick Man’s pogo stick.

steps.text: Play @loc{Lonely at the top} by Essssssh as @npc{Pogostick Man} and use the level’s jump setup to reach 10 meters.

achievements.description: Eject, Frontflip, and Reconnect to Motorized Shopping Cart
achievements.summary: Eject from Effective Shopper’s cart, perform a frontflip, and reattach to the cart.

steps.text: Play @loc{Power Move (Steam)} by imseascug as @npc{Effective Shopper}.
Press @mechanic{Z} to eject and complete one forward flip.
Bring your hands back to the cart’s steering bar and hold @mechanic{Space} to reconnect. Restart if an injury prevents you from grabbing the bar.

achievements.description: Carry Yourself With Your Own Magnet
achievements.summary: Lift Helicopter Guy with his own helicopter’s magnet.

steps.text: Play @loc{Autopilot Achiev} by Plectros as @npc{Helicopter Guy}. Activate the magnet, then eject into the magnet’s reach so your helicopter lifts you.

achievements.description: Carry a Living Child to Victory
achievements.summary: Finish a level with a living child carried by Helicopter Guy’s magnet.

steps.text: Play @loc{Savior} by zaporeprx as @npc{Helicopter Guy}. Press @mechanic{Space} to pick up the child with the magnet, then carry the child alive to the finish.

achievements.summary: Have Irresponsible Dad’s son die 500 times.

steps.text: Play @loc{Damn It Achievement} by ayyyyyyyyyyykapu as @npc{Irresponsible Dad}. Let the son die and restart until the counter reaches 500.

achievements.description: Lose Both Arms While Hanging On
achievements.summary: Lose both arms while your character is hanging on by the hands.

steps.text: Play @loc{Tenacious Achieve} by Pixelzocker. Keep your character gripping the hanging object until both arms tear off.

achievements.summary: Have your character killed by a falling toilet.

steps.text: Play @loc{not like this} by Rayhan447 as @npc{Pogostick Man} and let the falling toilet kill your character.

achievements.summary: Defeat Gravelord Tito and finish PARK SOULS.

steps.text: Find @loc{PARK SOULS} by ofyuk and ride through the skeleton fights to @enemy{Gravelord Tito}.
Wait for Tito’s swinging arm to form a ramp. Ride up the arm and launch the bike onto his head.
Rock the bike against Tito’s head until he dies, then ride onward to the finish.

achievements.summary: Break the biscuits carried in Effective Shopper’s shopping basket.

steps.text: Choose @npc{Effective Shopper} and drive over a landmine to scatter the groceries. Crush the biscuits from the basket.

achievements.summary: Have Helicopter Guy’s pelvis destroyed.

steps.text: Play @loc{WeirdFrozenCavern1.1} as @npc{Helicopter Guy}. Reach the laser section and let a laser destroy your character’s pelvis.

achievements.description: Achieve Victory on Segway Without Feet
achievements.summary: Finish a level on Segway Guy’s Segway after losing both feet.

steps.text: Play @loc{UPPER BODY STRENGTH} by Saplak121 as @npc{Segway Guy}. Lose both feet while staying on the Segway, then reach the finish.

achievements.description: Achieve Victory as a Mourning Father
achievements.summary: Finish a level as Irresponsible Dad after his son has died.

guide.context: Dismissing a passenger with Ctrl does not count as a death.

steps.text: Play @loc{Hed Have Wanted This} by moppy777 as @npc{Irresponsible Dad}. Let the passenger die, then take the surviving rider to the finish.

achievements.description: Achieve Victory as a Mourning Mother
achievements.summary: Finish a level as Irresponsible Mom after both of her children have died.

guide.context: Dismissing a passenger with Ctrl does not count as a death.

steps.text: Play @loc{my kids dont call} by snif_snif as @npc{Irresponsible Mom}. Let the passengers die, then take the surviving rider to the finish.

achievements.summary: Finish a level as the male rider of Moped Couple after the female passenger has died.

guide.context: Dismissing a passenger with Ctrl does not count as a death.

steps.text: Play @loc{Ready to Mingle Ach.} by Azortics as @npc{Moped Couple}. Let the passenger die, then take the surviving rider to the finish.

achievements.description: Achieve Victory With 20 Arrows in Your Body
achievements.summary: Finish a level with at least 20 arrows lodged in your character’s body.

steps.text: Play @loc{alternative medicine} by ratjelly_. Survive with at least 20 arrows embedded in your character and reach the finish before dying.

achievements.summary: Finish a level without making your character move.

steps.text: Start @loc{Lethargic} by Acrylics and leave the movement controls untouched until the level finishes.

achievements.summary: Survive a spike impalement and then finish the level.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forget My Past Acevm} by Primehitfire. Let a spike impale your character, then reach the finish alive.

achievements.summary: Finish a level while your character is bleeding out.

steps.text: Play @loc{at what cost} by Sorinos07 as @npc{Segway Guy}. Let the setup tear your body open, then reach the finish before the bleeding kills you.

achievements.summary: Finish a level after losing both arms and both legs.

steps.text: Play @loc{I do things my way} by amberthekid. Let the level remove both arms and both legs, then stay alive through the finish.

achievements.description: Beat Happy Green Hills in Less Than 10 Seconds
achievements.summary: Complete Happy Green Hills with a finishing time below 10 seconds.

steps.text: Open @loc{Happy Green Hills} from Featured Levels and choose @npc{Pogostick Man}.
Eject immediately with @mechanic{Z} and hold @mechanic{Down + Left} so you land facing the ground.
Release Down, then hold Down again to shuffle onto the starting landmine. Use the blast to launch toward the finish and restart until your finishing time is under 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Beat Obstacle Course? In Less than 20 Seconds
achievements.summary: Finish Obstacle Course? in under 20 seconds.

steps.text: Open @loc{Obstacle Course?} in Featured Levels. Watch the fastest winning replay to learn the route, then practice until you finish in under 20 seconds.

achievements.summary: Finish every winnable Featured Level.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Play} on the main menu and work through the Featured Levels, finishing every level that has a victory condition.
For a level you cannot finish, open its replay list and watch a winning run to learn the route before trying again.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Wheelchair Guy
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Wheelchair Guy.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Mountain Swings}, @loc{Godwin the Goat}, and @loc{1. Starving Hobo} as @npc{Wheelchair Guy}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Segway Guy
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Segway Guy.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Renaissance Ravager}, @loc{Prehistoric Pilgrim}, and @loc{The Seginators} as @npc{Segway Guy}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Irresponsible Dad
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Irresponsible Dad.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Speed Bridge}, @loc{BMX_Park II}, and @loc{--=Obst. Course=--} as @npc{Irresponsible Dad}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Effective Shopper
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Effective Shopper.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Subway Rampage}, @loc{string}, and @loc{GalacticBountyHunter} as @npc{Effective Shopper}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Moped Couple
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Moped Couple.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Four Seasons}, @loc{headshoter !!!!!}, and @loc{Dragon Flight School} as @npc{Moped Couple}.

achievements.displayName: I Had a Job To Do
achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Lawnmower Man
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Lawnmower Man.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{The Combine 2.1}, @loc{Ultimate Payback!}, and @loc{Rap Battle 3} as @npc{Lawnmower Man}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Explorer Guy
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Explorer Guy.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{The Legacy of Quezal}, @loc{GalacticBountyHunter}, and @loc{I Save You Indy} as @npc{Explorer Guy}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Santa Claus
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Santa Claus.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{North Pole Rush}, @loc{Bigfoot Forest}, and @loc{BOSS BATTLE MEDLEY} as @npc{Santa Claus}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Pogostick Man
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Pogostick Man.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Pogoventure}, @loc{True Ninja Ropeswing}, and @loc{WASTELAND 2} as @npc{Pogostick Man}.

achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Irresponsible Mom
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Irresponsible Mom.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Original Level 3}, @loc{An Elephant ...}, and @loc{WeirdFrozenCavern1.1} as @npc{Irresponsible Mom}.

achievements.displayName: Success in the Face of Turbulence
achievements.description: Beat 3 Featured Levels With Helicopter Guy
achievements.summary: Finish three different Featured Levels as Helicopter Guy.

steps.text: In Featured Levels, finish @loc{Happy Concert v2.0}, @loc{Bigfoot Forest}, and @loc{BOSS BATTLE MEDLEY} as @npc{Helicopter Guy}.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 playtests in the level editor.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Level Editor} from the main menu. Press @mechanic{T} to start a playtest, then T again to return to editing. Complete this cycle 10 times.

achievements.summary: Save a replay of a level.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account. Play a level, press @mechanic{Tab}, choose @mechanic{Save Replay}, then select @mechanic{Save}.

achievements.description: Save a Replay Beating a Level You Created
achievements.summary: Save a winning replay of a published level you created.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account. In @mechanic{Level Editor}, make a simple level with a reachable finish line, test the level, then save and publish it.
Play your published level and reach the finish. Press @mechanic{Tab}, choose @mechanic{Save Replay}, then select @mechanic{Save}.

achievements.summary: Submit a rating for one level.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account using the upper-left panel. Open a level and submit a rating from 1 to 5 for the level.

achievements.summary: Submit a rating for 10 different levels.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account using the upper-left panel. Open 10 different levels and submit a rating from 1 to 5 for each level.

achievements.summary: Add five different levels to your favorites.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account. Open five different levels and select the yellow @mechanic{Add to favorites} button on each one.

achievements.summary: Cause a total of 5,000 character deaths.

steps.text: Play @loc{Kills Farm} by Ternavskiy and kill the NPCs. Replay the level until the death counter reaches 5,000.

achievements.summary: Cover a total distance of 10 kilometers.

steps.text: Build up 10 kilometers of movement. For a dedicated distance level, search the Level Browser for @loc{Oh My Legs} by BAJ19l__.

achievements.summary: Cover a total distance of 100 kilometers.

steps.text: Build up 100 kilometers of movement. For a dedicated distance level, search the Level Browser for @loc{Oh My Legs} by BAJ19l__.

achievements.summary: Cover a total distance of 1,000 kilometers.

steps.text: Build up 1,000 kilometers of movement. For a dedicated distance level, search the Level Browser for @loc{Oh My Legs} by BAJ19l__.

achievements.summary: Play 10 different levels.

steps.text: Finish 10 different levels. Choose short @mechanic{Achievement} or @mechanic{Dont Move} levels for quick completions.

achievements.summary: Play 100 different levels.

steps.text: Finish 100 different levels. Choose short @mechanic{Achievement} or @mechanic{Dont Move} levels for quick completions.

achievements.summary: Play 1,000 different levels.

steps.text: Finish 1,000 different levels. Choose short @mechanic{Achievement} or @mechanic{Dont Move} levels for quick completions.

achievements.description: Achieve Victory After Losing Your Employees
achievements.summary: Finish a level as Santa Claus after losing both elves.

steps.text: Play @loc{Self-Made Steam Ach.} by Morningsun87 as @npc{Santa Claus}. Lose both elves, then reach the finish as Santa.

achievements.displayName: All I Care About is Gold
achievements.summary: Collect a total of 100 tokens.

steps.text: Play @loc{Token Farm} by Ternavskiy and collect at least 100 tokens.

achievements.description: Submit a Record Time on A Level With at least 10 Competitors
achievements.summary: Submit a new fastest winning replay on a level with at least 10 existing competitors.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account. Open a level’s replays and find a level with winning times from at least 10 other players. Ignore entries with no finishing time.
Watch the fastest replay, then finish in a strictly faster time.
Choose @mechanic{Save Replay}, select @mechanic{Save}, and wait for the successful-save message.

achievements.description: Submit a Record Time on 5 Levels With at least 10 Competitors
achievements.summary: Submit a new fastest winning replay on 5 different levels with at least 10 existing competitors on each level.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account. Open a level’s replays and find a level with winning times from at least 10 other players. Ignore entries with no finishing time.
Watch the fastest replay, then finish in a strictly faster time.
Choose @mechanic{Save Replay}, select @mechanic{Save}, and wait for the successful-save message. Earn and save records this way on 5 different levels.

achievements.description: Submit a Record Time on 25 Levels With at least 10 Competitors
achievements.summary: Submit a new fastest winning replay on 25 different levels with at least 10 existing competitors on each level.

steps.text: Sign in to your Happy Wheels account. Open a level’s replays and find a level with winning times from at least 10 other players. Ignore entries with no finishing time.
Watch the fastest replay, then finish in a strictly faster time.
Choose @mechanic{Save Replay}, select @mechanic{Save}, and wait for the successful-save message. Earn and save records this way on 25 different levels.
